title: FAR_NZY S₀ decision record
description: One human-verified (or OPTIMAL-labeled) decision from Farkle Frenzy. A corpus is an array of these. C(σ) = fraction of rows where an evolved policy reproduces `decision`.

decisionType.description: Which decision this row captures (verified against monteCarlo.ts / farkleScorer.ts).

seed.description: csprng seed; the row is fully reproducible from it.

state.description: State features that drive the decision. Fields present depend on decisionType.

unbanked.description: accumulated unbanked points this turn (drives playerContinue)

options.description: Legal choices at this decision point. For CHAIN_SELECT, each option carries the scoreFarkle result.

oneOf.description: e.g. CONTINUE | BANK | USE | SKIP | PASS

decision.description: The correct/observed choice: a string, or the index into options for CHAIN_SELECT.

labelSource.description: PRIMARY anchor is HUMAN_TELEMETRY/HUMAN_REPLAY (per GLASSBOX_DNA_IMPLEMENTATION §8 D5 / §12: 'correct' = fun + human-aligned, KL 0.1-0.3, win>95% is an exploit). OPTIMAL/AVERAGE/WEAK (monteCarlo PlayerModel) bound the space + detect exploits, they are NOT ground truth.

verifiedBy.description: e.g. telemetry:session-<id>, human name for replay rows, or monteCarlo:OPTIMAL@<engine-sha> for bounding rows

fitness.description: D5 fitness breakdown (handoff §8): weights spatial_entropy 0.10, human_drl_alignment 0.10, win_rate 0.15, engagement 0.25, fun_score 0.25, exploit_free 0.15. C(σ) grades on fitness + KL-to-human, not win-rate.

humanTelemetry.description: W10 human telemetry signals (handoff §8 W10) that anchor HUMAN_TELEMETRY rows.

scorerContext.description: optional: EV of continue vs bank, argmax margin, exploit-ceiling flag, etc.
